text:
maria: quick idea 1f4a1 add a 'Cost lineage' toggle to the cost card to overlay inferred per-route cache savings + per-model splits. default off.

sam: love it. show absolute token savings and percent of route cost saved. surface sampling_rate and whether savings are from prefetch vs hotpath.

jordan: telemetry notes: we emit cache_hit and prefetch events and some requests have route_id. linking across async chains is flaky; origin_route_id is often null. risk: double-crediting when a prefetch feeds multiple routes.

lee: heuristic: when origin_route_id null, attribute to most recent authenticated route within 30s, else proportionally split by token-length. mark those attributions with low confidence.

sam: backend todo: 1) add origin_route_id (nullable) to cache_hit events 2) nightly reconcile job to dedupe credits 3) internal API /internal/v1/cost_lineage returning route_id, model, savings_usd, confidence, sampling_factor. keep internal for now.

maria: UX: toggle in cost card top-right with tooltip: 'Infer cache savings + per-model breakdown. Confidence shown when heuristics or sampling used.' click row to open explain flyout.

jordan: reconcile protosql to find ambiguous prefetches and apportion:

select prefetch_id, array_agg(distinct origin_route_id) as routes, sum(savings_tokens) as total_savings
from cache_hits where ts > now() - interval '7 days' group by prefetch_id;

then if single route grant full credit, else weight by candidate route token share.

lee: sampling nuance 63a0 some proxies sample cache hits at 1/10. surface sampling_factor and widen confidence intervals when sampling or heuristics used.

sam: api example (internal): GET /internal/v1/cost_lineage?start=..&end=.. returns [{route_id:"r_123",model:"redwood-4x",savings_tokens:"12345",savings_usd:"12.34",confidence:"0.87",sampling_factor:"10"}, ...]

maria: rollout: feature-flagged + tenant opt-in beta (10 tenants) -> collect feedback -> GA. acceptance: toggle present (off by default), API returns per-route savings+confidence, explain flyout, reconcile worker with dry-run, beta gating.

jordan: ops alert: fire if reconcile attributed_savings deviates >12% vs raw cache_hits week-over-week. emit reconciliation metrics.

ops-bot: reconcile-worker/run completed (1712320200) :white_check_mark: records_processed=19876 reconciled_prefetches=1742 deviation_pct=2.4

sam: i'll mock the cost card and explain flyout tomorrow. tagging @maria for acceptance checks.
